biography: Bianca Ferri Marini is the CEO and Founder of Moirai 3, a web-based SaaS platform that lets fashion designers, brands, students and retailers create customized 3D garments and export production-ready 3D Fashion Tech Packs from a library of ready-made templates, with no 3D skills required.

about.title: Career
about.text: She studied at the Accademia Italiana di Arte, Moda e Design in Rome and has 7+ years in tailoring and costume design and 5+ years in digital and 3D apparel design, combining creative direction and styling with 3D technology.

about.title: Software & Skills
about.text: CLO3D · Digital patternmaking · Fabric simulation · Texturing · Rendering · Tailoring · Patternmaking

about.title: Exhibitions
items: Finalist and First Prize, Dubai Expo 2020 (3D fashion and gaming project)
Fashion designer showcasing at Altaroma, Rome Fashion Week
Phygital designer showcasing at Digital Fashion Week, NYC and Paris

about.title: Collaborations
items: Designer and stylist for Eyelet Milano, a clothing brand
Costume designer for the Netflix series I Medici: Masters of Florence and Leonardo
Moirai 3 is a member of the NVIDIA Inception Program (2025–2026)
Moirai 3 is an official partner of VMOD, South Korea’s leading digital fabric library.
